items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Who did Pickin' Inny? [INTERVIEWEE] He didn't play with no man.

ctx.x: See, these are all new names to me. Professor Young. I never, I never knew who he played with. I never knew who Pickin' Inny played with. Who did Pickin' Inny?
He didn't play with no man.
